lines.text: &fLand you own. A plot is a claimed area that other players cannot build in, break in, or take from.

&7The picture is the plot area seen from above, one pixel to one block. Click a plot to select it &8- the panel on the right tells you whether it is free, what it costs, and who owns it if anyone does.
&7Select a free plot and confirm. The price is taken in Starcoins straight away and the land is yours from that moment.
&7You can sell a plot you own back to the server. &cThis asks for confirmation because it cannot be undone&7 &8- and anything you leave built on it is no longer protected once it is sold.
&7Clear out what you want to keep &fbefore&7 selling.
&8Building outside a plot is allowed, but nothing out there is protected.
